narrationTexts: Now applying edits to all 12 files.

finalText:
**Migration finished.** 12 files moved from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched — its header says it's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade and local edits are lost.

Only `db.query` remains anywhere. Next: nothing.
